name: FilterBar
description: Labelled filters on one line that fold behind one button when the line no longer fits.

children.description: The filters: FilterBar.Item nodes, each holding one control

label.description: Names the group, the folded button and the sheet's title

activeCount.description: How many filters differ from their defaults; the folded button shows it and Reset is disabled at 0

onReset.description: Puts every filter back to its default; without it the sheet has no Reset

doneLabel.description: The sheet's closing action; say what the person will see ("Show 14 companies")

collapse.description: auto folds while the filters do not fit the room the bar is given; always and never fix it

size.description: Size of the folded button and the sheet's actions; match the controls

when: Two or more filters above a table or list that must stay usable on a phone
A toolbar whose filters compete with actions for one row
whenNot: One filter: place the Select or SearchInput on its own
Filters that need applying as a batch: use a Dialog with a form and a submit
Switching views of the same data: use Tabs or ToggleGroup
guidelines: One control per FilterBar.Item; the label names it on the line and in the sheet
Filters apply as they change, so doneLabel says the result ("Show 14 companies")
Pass activeCount and onReset so the folded button shows how much is filtered and the sheet can undo it
Give the bar the toolbar's free room (it grows to fill a flex row) and keep actions outside it
accessibility: On the line the filters sit in role="group" named by label
Each Item is a Field, so its label names the control
The folded button reads its label and the active count ("Filters 2 active"); the sheet is a dialog titled by label

examples.name: Table Filters
examples.description: Filters beside a table's actions; they fold behind one button on narrow screens.
examples.code:
import { Select } from '@/components/Select';

<FilterBar size="sm" activeCount={1} onReset={() => {}} doneLabel="Show 3 companies">
  <FilterBar.Item label="Owner">
    <Select size="sm" defaultValue="noah">
      <Select.Trigger />
      <Select.Content>
        <Select.Item value="all">All owners</Select.Item>
        <Select.Item value="noah">Noah Lee</Select.Item>
      </Select.Content>
    </Select>
  </FilterBar.Item>
  <FilterBar.Item label="Stage">
    <Select size="sm" defaultValue="any">
      <Select.Trigger />
      <Select.Content>
        <Select.Item value="any">Any</Select.Item>
        <Select.Item value="pilot">Pilot</Select.Item>
      </Select.Content>
    </Select>
  </FilterBar.Item>
</FilterBar>

relations.note: The usual control inside a FilterBar.Item
Each FilterBar.Item is a Field, so its label names the control
The folded filters open in a bottom sheet below the sm breakpoint
The folded filters open in a popover from sm up

propsSummary: children: FilterBar.Item nodes - one control each
activeCount + onReset - the count on the folded button and the sheet's Reset
